reviews.title: Misleading and Deceptive Advertising
reviews.text:
I came across this app through a Facebook ad that clearly made it seem like you could look up a phone number and track someone’s location discreetly. That is NOT how this app works at all.

When I first downloaded it, it asked for the phone number and acted like it was finding the location. Then I was prompted to pay around $8, which I did. Only after paying did it tell me that the person must give permission and receive a request to join the app.

How is that “tracking” at all? The ad strongly implies you can secretly see someone’s location, but instead it sends them a message asking permission, which completely defeats the purpose and is NOT what was advertised.
